title: AgentGuard Inbound IoT Telemetry
description: Strict structural validation contract for decentralized MedTech bioreactor sensors.

agent_key.description: Required for Edge Proxy Authentication to prevent 403 Hard Drops.

equipment_id.description: Unique identifier for Volumetric RPM tracking in the Redis-mock.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the hardware observation.

critical_alert.description: Life-safety hardware flag. If true, bypasses the 429 RPM volumetric quota.

temperature_c.description: Biological temperature. Structural failure (e.g., passing a string instead of a float) triggers a 422 Quarantine.

bioreactor_rpm.description: Mechanical rotation speed of the synthesis equipment.
